name: Robert
text: the sink in the staff kitchen is leaking under the trap, Robert says the cupboard is getting damp. can he ring the plumber b4 it rots

name: Mangiapia
text: the trolley with the broken wheel is in the corridor by the lifts, its been tagged a week n nobody collected it. Mangiapia thinks the repair firm only picks up on tuesdays so it might sit there till then, can u chase the ticket

name: Beltrán Alexandra-Corina
text: the archive room extraction has packed in again n the air gets thick up there after an hour, ive put the spare desk fan in the doorway to move some air around. Beltrán Alexandra-Corina from facilities says the part is on order but nobody knows when it lands, so if you can chase it that would help

name: Dedo Azmi Siep
text: the roof access hatch leaks when it rains hard, Dedo Azmi Siep put a bucket up there n it fills in a day

name: Eloy
text: the fire door on the second floor keeps catching on the frame n you have to shoulder it open, i watched Eloy from maintenance adjust it on monday but its sticking again already. can he come back with the proper tool this time

name: Olsen
text: the loading bay drain stinks in warm weather n the grate is half blocked with leaves, i rodded what i could reach but the smell is back every time it rains. Olsen from the grounds team says the run needs jetting proper, can we get a camera down it b4 the summer rush

name: Seitova Dongphu
text: the studio lights cut out twice during the shoot last nite, Seitova Dongphu swapped the breaker but it tripped again after ten mins. the band is back tomorow

name: Téo Hunziker
text: the kitchen dishwasher leaves grit on the glasses since the salt ran out, Téo Hunziker refilled it but the rinse still comes up cloudy. those glasses are going out to guests so it needs sorting, maybe the filter needs a clean as well

name: Driton
text: two of the aisle lights have been out since friday n the far end of the building is pitch dark after six. Driton swapped the tubes but the fitting itself looks corroded, so the whole unit probably needs replacing. the night crew has been using torches down there. can the electrician price it up this week

name: Biesenkamp
text: the tumble dryer in the laundry takes three cycles to dry a load n the timer sticks, Biesenkamp looked n says the heating element is on its way out.

name: Bernadeta Stewénius
text: the meeting room booking system has double booked the big room three times this week, Bernadeta Stewénius showed me the clash on her screen so its not just me being daft. the calendar needs a proper sync b4 the client visit on thursday

name: Denial Rokas
text: the recycling bins out back havent been emptied for two weeks n theyre overflowing onto the path, Denial Rokas rang the council on monday n got a reference number but nothing has moved since. the foxes got into the bags last nite n made a right mess, can someone chase it again b4 the inspection

name: Janita
text: The garden table delivery was split across two trips and the frames were stacked in the shed. Janita checked the bolts against the packing list before the rain.

name: Monroe
text: The pottery kiln was reassembled after the element swap, and Monroe ran a test firing to Cone 6 before the evening class. The controller held the ramp without a fault and the lid seal was reseated. The next bisque load goes in on Thursday.

name: Coos Macalou
text: The beekeeping course wrapped up with the practical session in the orchard and the hives were closed for the winter. Coos Macalou collected the suits for dry cleaning and stored the smokers in the shed. The membership renewals go out next month with the new insurance cover noted on the form.

name: Sutaj Gomo Raffael
text: The rowing shed was cleared of the winter covers and the oars were racked by length. Sutaj Gomo Raffael patched the trailer tyre before the regatta entry went in.

name: Sathiyaseelan
text: The paint store was audited for the quarter by the area supervisor, and Sathiyaseelan logged the opened tins with their dates on the board. Two part tins were binned and the solvent cabinet was restocked.

name: Bekhechi
text: The cycle racks were moved to the east wall while the courtyard resurfacing ran and the old anchors were ground off. Bekhechi marked the bays with the new numbers before the paint fully cured. The security team will keep an eye on the gate while the works continue into next week. Bike counts went up again this month.

name: Petereit Urani
text: The choir risers were returned to the hall and the keyboard was locked in the vestry. Petereit Urani sorted the sheet music into the new folders.

name: Bosshard Folly Käsermann
text: The spring bulb order arrived and the crates were stacked in the cool shed. Bosshard Folly Käsermann counted the varieties against the invoice and set aside the damaged crate for credit. Planting starts once the beds are turned over.

name: Kaede
text: The maritime museum loan cases were wrapped and crated under the conservator's eye and the courier van was booked for the morning. Kaede checked the condition notes against the photos before the lids went on. The crates travel upright and the climate loggers were started at packing. The return leg is pencilled in for the autumn.

name: Hulina
text: The hedge trimmings were burned on the allotment bonfire and the ash was spread the next day. Hulina sharpened the loppers for the weekend crew.

name: Wenqing Borko
text: The seed swap table was cleared at the end of the fete and the leftover packets went to the school garden. Wenqing Borko catalogued the donations by sowing month. The library asked for a set for the spring display.

name: Mccaw Falkner Bazzano
text: The tool store was reorganized over the weekend and the shadow boards were moved a bay closer to the bench. Mccaw Falkner Bazzano labelled the drawers with the torque settings for each kit. The calibration stickers were renewed on the morning round. A spare shadow board was ordered for the second bench by the window.

name: Eniola
text: the cloakroom rail came off the wall again n the coats ended up on the floor, can someone bring the longer screws from the van, Eniola

name: Jaluna
text: the photocopier on the landing keeps pulling two sheets at once n ive cleared the rollers twice already, the engineer is booked for tuesday but weve got the audits monday so if anyone has a workaround plz shout, Jaluna

name: Santhi Farzana
text: the recycling collection missed our street again this week n the bins are stacked down the alley behind the shop, i rang the depot n they said a lorry broke down so theyre running a day behind, if its not picked up by friday we should log a complaint with photos this time, Santhi Farzana

name: Van Meteren
text: the gutter above the fire exit drips onto the step n its lethal when it freezes, can we get it looked at b4 someone slips, Van Meteren

name: Türker
text: the air con in the server room has been noisy since the service n now its not cooling, the temp alarm went off at 3am n i had to open the door to let heat out, the contractor needs a call today, Türker

name: Kollitsch
text: the delivery yard floods every time it rains hard n the drain cover is buried under the new gravel, i nearly went over on it wheeling the pallet truck n the lads have been joking about needing wellies, we need the groundworks back to lift it n re seat it properly, Kollitsch

name: Karanfil Pellizzon
text: the hand dryer in the disabled loo has died again n the paper towels ran out yday, can we get a new one ordered, Karanfil Pellizzon

name: Azalea Blenda
text: the picnic benches by the pond have been vandalised again n two slats are gone, the splinters are a hazard for the kids club so weve taped them off, the wood is in the workshop but we need someone to fit it, Azalea Blenda

name: Grozdan
text: the overnight gate light has been flickering for weeks n now it stays off until you tap the post, the cameras are useless with it dark so security have been doing foot patrols which they arent happy about, the electrician said the fitting is sealed n needs replacing not fixing, can we book that in, Grozdan

name: Lee
text: the milk fridge in the corridor is set too cold n the bottles are freezing solid overnight, can someone turn the dial down a notch, Lee

name: Nuseiba Naron
text: the stair carpet on the west side is coming away at the nosing n its a trip hazard, ive put tape down twice but it lifts within a day, the fitters said the flight needs re stretching which is a bigger job, Nuseiba Naron

name: Sadil Zöger
text: the drinks machine has been swallowing coins again n the refund button does nothing, ppl have lost a few quid between them n its winding everyone up, the label on the side says ring the vendor but the number is out of date, ive put a sign on it saying out of order until someone comes, Sadil Zöger

name: Represa
text: the pool changing rooms ran out of hot water at the weekend n the swimmers were not happy, the boiler reset fixed it for now, Represa

name: Agil
text: The west gate barrier was tested after the sensor swap and every pass read clean on the first attempt. The logs were backed up to the office drive. The spare battery was fitted and the old one went for recycling, as noted by Agil.

name: Verzaro
text: The herb bed was weeded and the mint was potted before it took over the path. The chives were split into three and two went to the front garden. The watering rota was updated for the warmer weeks and the tap timer was reset. The compost bay was turned, and the new batch was covered, checked by Verzaro.

name: Maryanne Mirta
text: The bird feeders were refilled and the fat balls replaced after the cold snap. The hedge was given a light trim, finished by Maryanne Mirta.

name: Giovanni Giani
text: The roof lantern was resealed at the ridge and the flashing was dressed back over the tiles. The patch was water tested with the hose and no drips came through. The scaffold was collected the same week, signed off by Giovanni Giani.

name: Marjut
text: The sander belts were replaced and the dust extraction was emptied before the bench was wiped down. The lacquer stock was counted and two tins were flagged as low. The offcut bin was emptied and the good lengths were racked by size. The workshop check was filed with the tool list, recorded by Marjut.

name: Scilanga
text: The pallet wrap stock was checked and the low bay was topped up from the overstock. The hand trucks were lined up by the dock, verified by Scilanga.

name: Kebreab Barzic Scanziani
text: The kiln shelves were scraped and re washed before the next glaze run. The pyrometer was checked against the reference probe and the reading matched. The shelf pins were sorted and the bent ones binned, confirmed by Kebreab Barzic Scanziani.

name: Ema Saschia
text: The launch trolley was cleaned and the rollers were greased ahead of the season. The slipway boards were checked for rot and the loose one was screwed down. The buoyancy aids were counted and the straps were replaced on four of them. The booking diary was moved online and the deposit column was updated, as logged by Ema Saschia.

name: Shihan
text: The water butts were emptied of leaves and the taps were checked for leaks. The greenhouse glass was washed, tidied by Shihan.

name: Farescour
text: The noticeboard was cleared of the old events and the new term dates went up by the door. The lost property box was sorted and the unclaimed items went to the charity shop. The key safe code was changed, witnessed by Farescour.

name: Shashkov Capararo
text: The stage lights were patched and the gel frames were cleaned before the run through. The follow spot was tested from the back of the hall and the beam was aligned on the mark. The props table was tidied and the spike marks were taped, as noted by Shashkov Capararo.

name: Ky Srilophian Demitri
text: The summerhouse cushions were aired and the windows were wiped inside and out. The decking was swept and the loose board was nailed, finished by Ky Srilophian Demitri.

name: Finn
text: The sample trays were washed and the labels were checked against the batch sheet. Two trays were re labelled after the print smudged. The incubator was emptied and the new run was loaded, verified by Finn.
